text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, out of the 4th corner and into the 
homestretch!! All the Umamusume are 
kicking into their final spurts!!

text_block_list.name: Stego & Bright
text_block_list.text: ――OOOAAAHHH!!!! ――Yaaahhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spe & Sky
text_block_list.text:
ââHAAAAAAAAHH!!!! 
ââYAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!!!!! And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooh! Stay Gold's generation is so 
strong~!! They don't lag behind Special 
Week and the others at all!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's way too early for a changing of the 
guard...! The spotlight still belongs to 
Stay Gold and the gang! Racing right now 
is seriously too hype!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Felt like I made real progress.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Look, Bright. Seems like we managed to 
show them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...For the sake of our pride."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Stego. On our next stage, let us 
compete as fellow Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Spring will never end. Not as long as I 
run.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to it.
――Stego-san!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, Spe and the gang.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, Stay Gold-san and the others 
are amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it means to carry an 
entire generation on your back...! I feel 
like I learned that firsthand from this 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... You're still as sharp as 
ever, it really makes me scratch my 
head...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —We are strong.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you engrave that deep into your 
mind. ...From here on out, as well."

...And so, this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
came to a close, with Stay Gold and the 
others magnificently showcasing their 
generation's pride—
――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...The Japan Cup is finally next.
choice_data_list:
Right here, right now, let's prove you're 
the strongest...!

Right here, right now, let's prove you're 
the strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Proof of being the strongest, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……In my "memories", the Japan Cup was 
always radiant.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Among them, two in particular are burned 
deep into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...One carried the hopes of countless 
people, defeated the world's strongest, 
and gave everyone a dream to believe in—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, where Special Week stood as 
Japan's Supreme Commander.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...From where I stand now, it was a 
battle that symbolized the golden age of 
racing, and—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“Special Week, standing as the victor... 
is the most dazzling sight to me.”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...And the other was what became the 
final domestic race for the other-world 
version of me—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup—where the End-of-Century 
Overlord, T.M. Opera O, was brought down 
by the beast of the new era, Jungle 
Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It was the race where the me from another 
world witnessed the changing of an era up 
close.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If history is anything to go by, surely... 
the upcoming Japan Cup will closely 
resemble one of their races.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And... precisely because of who I am now, 
there must be something only I can do in 
each of these races.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What do you think would be interesting for 
me to aim for in the 'Japan Cup'?
choice_data_list:
Let us challenge the symbol of the golden 
age, the most dazzling existence of all.

Don't leave it to someone else— change the 
era with your own hands

Don't leave it to another— change the era 
with your own hands

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What do you think would be interesting for 
me to aim for in the 'Japan Cup'?
choice_data_list:
Let us challenge the symbol of the golden 
age, the most dazzling existence of all.

Don't leave it to someone else— change the 
era with your own hands

Don't leave it to another— change the era 
with your own hands

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: To the strongest version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan, why don't you take a little 
break? You've been pushing yourself this 
whole time...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm okay...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Suzuka-san... Could we 
run together one more time...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the Tenno Sho (Autumn) the 
other day ended, I've been in great 
shape... and I feel like I can get even 
stronger...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I really want to win...! Against 
SteGo-san...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: To Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I told you too that I'm aiming to 
become the number one Umamusume in Japan, 
didn't I, Suzuka-san?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. ...She said it was a promise with 
her mother."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Until a little while ago, I was pretty 
vague on what it actually meant to be 
Japan's number one horse girl, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Watching you, Stego-san, made me think.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Running in so many races... Competing with 
so many strong Umamusume... Leaving behind 
so many results—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And being cheered on by so many people.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Number One Umamusume in Japan' that 
I've been aiming for... I feel like 
SteGo-san is remarkably close to that—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Senpai is... the best in Japan...――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"So, if I want to become the number one 
horse girl in Japan, I know I have to 
surpass Stego-san—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what I think...!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ......I understand, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Shall we run a little more? ...Because I 
want to see the view beyond Senpai too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...! Thank you so much!!

Causality accelerates, toward the stage of 
the decisive battle, the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No more just being a spectator. This time, 
I'll be the one to—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Decide the era.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Pokke. Seriously, let's take a rest 
soon. Any more will affect the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not yet...! Please, Fuji-san. Just a 
little longer, please stay with me...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since watching the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) the other day, I just haven't 
been able to hold back...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I can get even stronger...! I 
ain't gonna let this feeling go to 
waste...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not just to beat Opera O, but to beat 
Stego as well...!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...To Stego-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...You understand too, don't you, 
Fuji-san? Who is currently closest to the 
"top."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Opera O is getting crazy strong at a 
freakishly monstrous speed. But still—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even before Opera's time, the one who's 
been dominating the Twinkle Series is 
Stego...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She enters tons of races, fights all kinds 
of strong opponents, and just keeps 
running without ever stopping...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Just being strong ain't enough to pull 
that off! I know it in my gut. He's got 
something. A kind of strength I don't have 
right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Unless I surpass that strength, no matter 
how much time passes, I'll never become 
the strongest I strive to be...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Does this mean another has 
fallen under the spell of that golden 
light—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, doesn't it look like Fuji-san 
actually has a lot of respect for Stego?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I definitely can't forgive 
that! So—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not to Stego, nor Opera O......! I'll show 
Fuji-san too......!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...to see who really is the strongest 
right now!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...! To think it was this much—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the Goddess of Destiny is 
quite an impatient one.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think that it intends to bestow its 
blessing upon both me and her...!

Causality accelerates, toward the stage of 
the decisive battle, the Japan Cup—
